close_quarters.name: Close Quarters
close_quarters.desc: Bonus bullet and melee damage against nearby enemies.

headshot_booster.name: Headshot Booster
headshot_booster.desc: Headshots deal bonus damage on a short cooldown.

high_velocity_rounds.name: High-Velocity Rounds
high_velocity_rounds.desc: Faster bullets and extra weapon damage.

monster_rounds.name: Monster Rounds
monster_rounds.desc: Stronger against troopers and jungle camps; helps you farm.

restorative_shot.name: Restorative Shot
restorative_shot.desc: Hitting enemies with bullets heals you periodically.

active_reload.name: Active Reload
active_reload.desc: Well-timed reloads grant fire rate and bullet lifesteal.

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.desc: Gain stacking weapon damage as you take damage.

fleetfoot.name: Fleetfoot
fleetfoot.desc: More move speed while shooting, plus extra ammo.

intensifying_magazine.name: Intensifying Magazine
intensifying_magazine.desc: Damage ramps up the longer you hold the trigger.

kinetic_dash.name: Kinetic Dash
kinetic_dash.desc: Dash-jumping grants a burst of fire rate and bonus ammo.

long_range.name: Long Range
long_range.desc: Bonus weapon damage against far-away targets.

melee_charge.name: Melee Charge
melee_charge.desc: Heavy melee hits harder and closes distance.

mystic_shot.name: Mystic Shot
mystic_shot.desc: Periodic bonus spirit damage on a bullet hit; scales with spirit.

opening_rounds.name: Opening Rounds
opening_rounds.desc: Extra damage against targets at high health.

slowing_bullets.name: Slowing Bullets
slowing_bullets.desc: Bullets slow the enemy you hit.

split_shot.name: Split Shot
split_shot.desc: Fire extra projectiles on a cooldown.

swift_striker.name: Swift Striker
swift_striker.desc: Big fire rate boost at the cost of some bullet resistance.

alchemical_fire.name: Alchemical Fire
alchemical_fire.desc: Throw a fire bomb that damages and boosts your bullets against targets inside.

burst_fire.name: Burst Fire
burst_fire.desc: Damaging heroes gives fire rate and move speed.

escalating_resilience.name: Escalating Resilience
escalating_resilience.desc: Shooting enemies builds up bullet resistance.

headhunter.name: Headhunter
headhunter.desc: Headshots deal bonus damage and heal you.

heroic_aura.name: Heroic Aura
heroic_aura.desc: Aura and active that boost allies' fire rate and speed.

point_blank.name: Point Blank
point_blank.desc: Bonus damage and a slow against close targets.

sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter
sharpshooter.desc: Large damage bonus at long range, with zoom.

tesla_bullets.name: Tesla Bullets
tesla_bullets.desc: Bullets sometimes chain lightning to nearby enemies.

toxic_bullets.name: Toxic Bullets
toxic_bullets.desc: Bullets build up a poison that also reduces healing.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.desc: At low health, gain fire rate, speed and resistance.

glass_cannon.name: Glass Cannon
glass_cannon.desc: Massive weapon damage, but less max health.

lucky_shot.name: Lucky Shot
lucky_shot.desc: Chance for bullets to deal bonus damage and slow.

ricochet.name: Ricochet
ricochet.desc: Bullets bounce to additional nearby enemies.

shadow_weave.name: Shadow Weave
shadow_weave.desc: Turn invisible; breaking stealth grants bonus damage.

silencer.name: Silencer
silencer.desc: Bullets build up and eventually silence the target.

spiritual_overflow.name: Spiritual Overflow
spiritual_overflow.desc: Sustained shooting grants spirit power and cooldown reduction.

vampiric_burst.name: Vampiric Burst
vampiric_burst.desc: Active: a burst of fire rate and bullet lifesteal. Also gives health and bullet resistance.

extra_health.name: Extra Health
extra_health.desc: A flat boost to max health.

extra_stamina.name: Extra Stamina
extra_stamina.desc: One more stamina charge and faster recovery.

healing_rite.name: Healing Rite
healing_rite.desc: Cast a heal-over-time on yourself or an ally.

enduring_speed.name: Enduring Speed
enduring_speed.desc: Move speed and resistance to slows.

healbane.name: Healbane
healbane.desc: Your spirit damage reduces enemy healing.

reactive_barrier.name: Reactive Barrier
reactive_barrier.desc: Automatic barrier when you get stunned or immobilized.

restorative_locket.name: Restorative Locket
restorative_locket.desc: Stores charges from enemy abilities, then heals.

return_fire.name: Return Fire
return_fire.desc: Reflect part of incoming damage back to attackers.

divine_barrier.name: Divine Barrier
divine_barrier.desc: Active: shield yourself or an ally.

fortitude.name: Fortitude
fortitude.desc: Big health pool and fast regen when not taking damage.

healing_nova.name: Healing Nova
healing_nova.desc: Active: heal yourself and nearby allies.

lifestrike.name: Lifestrike
lifestrike.desc: Heavy melee heals you and slows the target.

majestic_leap.name: Majestic Leap
majestic_leap.desc: Active: launch high into the air.

metal_skin.name: Metal Skin
metal_skin.desc: Active: become nearly immune to bullets briefly.

rescue_beam.name: Rescue Beam
rescue_beam.desc: Active: heal an ally and pull them toward you.

veil_walker.name: Veil Walker
veil_walker.desc: Passing through veils grants invisibility and speed.

colossus.name: Colossus
colossus.desc: Active: grow huge, gain resistances and slow nearby enemies.

diviners_kevlar.name: Diviner's Kevlar
diviners_kevlar.desc: Using your ultimate grants a big barrier and spirit power.

inhibitor.name: Inhibitor
inhibitor.desc: Bullets reduce enemy damage, movement and healing.

phantom_strike.name: Phantom Strike
phantom_strike.desc: Active: teleport to an enemy, damage and disarm them.

siphon_bullets.name: Siphon Bullets
siphon_bullets.desc: Hitting heroes steals max health from them.

unstoppable.name: Unstoppable
unstoppable.desc: Active: immune to stuns and most crowd control.

witchmail.name: Witchmail
witchmail.desc: Spirit resistance; taking spirit damage reduces your cooldowns.

extra_charge.name: Extra Charge
extra_charge.desc: Charged abilities gain an extra charge.

infuser.name: Infuser
infuser.desc: Active: temporary spirit power and spirit lifesteal. Also gives health and spirit resistance.

mystic_burst.name: Mystic Burst
mystic_burst.desc: Big ability hits deal bonus damage on a cooldown.

spirit_strike.name: Spirit Strike
spirit_strike.desc: Melee hits deal spirit damage and lower spirit resistance.

cold_front.name: Cold Front
cold_front.desc: Active: an icy blast that damages and slows around you.

decay.name: Decay
decay.desc: Active: damage over time that also reduces healing.

mystic_vulnerability.name: Mystic Vulnerability
mystic_vulnerability.desc: Your spirit damage reduces enemy spirit resistance.

quicksilver_reload.name: Quicksilver Reload
quicksilver_reload.desc: Using an ability reloads part of your magazine with bonus damage.

slowing_hex.name: Slowing Hex
slowing_hex.desc: Active: slow and silence movement abilities of a target.

suppressor.name: Suppressor
suppressor.desc: Your spirit damage reduces enemy fire rate.

knockdown.name: Knockdown
knockdown.desc: Active: delayed stun that pulls a target to the ground.

rapid_recharge.name: Rapid Recharge
rapid_recharge.desc: Faster charge recovery and extra charges.

surge_of_power.name: Surge of Power
surge_of_power.desc: Imbue an ability: casting it grants speed and fire rate.

tankbuster.name: Tankbuster
tankbuster.desc: Bonus damage scaling with the target's max health.

boundless_spirit.name: Boundless Spirit
boundless_spirit.desc: Huge spirit power and extra health.

echo_shard.name: Echo Shard
echo_shard.desc: Active: instantly reset your last ability.

escalating_exposure.name: Escalating Exposure
escalating_exposure.desc: Your spirit damage stacks increasing vulnerability.

ethereal_shift.name: Ethereal Shift
ethereal_shift.desc: Active: become untargetable and invulnerable briefly.

mystic_reverb.name: Mystic Reverb
mystic_reverb.desc: Imbue an ability: hits echo for extra damage and slow.

refresher.name: Refresher
refresher.desc: Active: reset all your ability cooldowns.

extended_magazine.name: Extended Magazine
extended_magazine.desc: More ammo and a little extra weapon damage.

recharging_rush.name: Recharging Rush
recharging_rush.desc: Bigger magazine and weapon damage, with a bonus after dealing a burst of damage.

spirit_shredder.name: Spirit Shredder
spirit_shredder.desc: Your bullets lower enemy spirit resistance, and your abilities heal you.

stalker.name: Stalker
stalker.desc: Quieter footsteps and move speed; a damage pulse near enemies lowers their bullet resistance.

ballistic_enchantment.name: Ballistic Enchantment
ballistic_enchantment.desc: Using abilities grants stacking weapon damage; also more ability range and duration.

blood_tribute.name: Blood Tribute
blood_tribute.desc: Active: spend health for fire rate, move speed and status resistance.

cultist_sacrifice.name: Cultist Sacrifice
cultist_sacrifice.desc: Bonus weapon damage and bullet resistance against troopers and camps; helps you farm.

express_shot.name: Express Shot
express_shot.desc: Faster bullets; periodically a shot deals big bonus damage.

hollow_point.name: Hollow Point
hollow_point.desc: Weapon damage and health; bullets lower enemy bullet resistance.

spirit_rend.name: Spirit Rend
spirit_rend.desc: Bullets stack up to lower enemy spirit resistance; abilities heal you.

weighted_shots.name: Weighted Shots
weighted_shots.desc: Weapon damage; repeated hits slow the target.

armor_piercer.name: Armor Piercer
armor_piercer.desc: Faster bullets with a chance to ignore part of enemy bullet resistance.

capacitor.name: Capacitor
capacitor.desc: Fire rate; shots can chain lightning between enemies and slow them.

crushing_fists.name: Crushing Fists
crushing_fists.desc: Much stronger melee; heavy melee stuns and lowers enemy bullet resistance.

spellslinger.name: Spellslinger
spellslinger.desc: Casting abilities stacks fire rate and reload speed; also cooldown reduction.

grit.name: Grit
grit.desc: Health regen out of combat and a barrier when a fight starts.

rebuttal.name: Rebuttal
rebuttal.desc: Successful parries heal you and boost your damage; also reduces melee damage taken.

battle_vest.name: Battle Vest
battle_vest.desc: Bullet resistance with a little weapon damage and fire rate.

enchanters_emblem.name: Enchanter's Emblem
enchanters_emblem.desc: Spirit resistance, spirit power and cooldown reduction.

guardian_ward.name: Guardian Ward
guardian_ward.desc: Active: give an ally a barrier and move speed.

spirit_shielding.name: Spirit Shielding
spirit_shielding.desc: A barrier when you take heavy spirit damage, plus spirit resistance.

trophy_collector.name: Trophy Collector
trophy_collector.desc: Stacks up over time to give sprint speed, ability range and extra souls.

weapon_shielding.name: Weapon Shielding
weapon_shielding.desc: A barrier when you take heavy bullet damage, plus bullet resistance.

bullet_resilience.name: Bullet Resilience
bullet_resilience.desc: High bullet resistance, with even more at low health.

counterspell.name: Counterspell
counterspell.desc: Parry an incoming ability to block it and heal. Also gives spirit power and health.

dispel_magic.name: Dispel Magic
dispel_magic.desc: Active: remove negative effects, heal and gain move speed.

fury_trance.name: Fury Trance
fury_trance.desc: Active: a burst of fire rate and move speed. Also gives bullet lifesteal and health.

spirit_resilience.name: Spirit Resilience
spirit_resilience.desc: High spirit resistance, with even more at low health.

stamina_mastery.name: Stamina Mastery
stamina_mastery.desc: More stamina, faster stamina recovery and better air control.

warp_stone.name: Warp Stone
warp_stone.desc: Active: teleport a short distance and gain bullet resistance.

cheat_death.name: Cheat Death
cheat_death.desc: Briefly prevents you from dying when you would take lethal damage.

healing_tempo.name: Healing Tempo
healing_tempo.desc: Healing you cast or receive grants fire rate and move speed; better regen.

indomitable.name: Indomitable
indomitable.desc: Bullet and spirit resistance plus a periodic barrier.

juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
juggernaut.desc: Resist slows and regenerate health; enemies who hit you get their fire rate slowed.

plated_armor.name: Plated Armor
plated_armor.desc: Health and a chance to deflect incoming bullets.

spellbreaker.name: Spellbreaker
spellbreaker.desc: Spirit resistance, status resistance and less damage from big spirit hits.

golden_goose_egg.name: Golden Goose Egg
golden_goose_egg.desc: Active: earn souls faster and sprint quicker, at the cost of dealing less damage.

rusted_barrel.name: Rusted Barrel
rusted_barrel.desc: Active: lower a target's fire rate and bullet resistance. Also gives some health.

arcane_surge.name: Arcane Surge
arcane_surge.desc: More stamina; dashing empowers your next ability with extra range and duration.

bullet_resist_shredder.name: Bullet Resist Shredder
bullet_resist_shredder.desc: Your spirit damage lowers enemy bullet resistance.

spirit_sap.name: Spirit Sap
spirit_sap.desc: Active: lower a target's spirit resistance and spirit power.

disarming_hex.name: Disarming Hex
disarming_hex.desc: Active: disarm a target so they can't shoot, and lower their bullet resistance.

greater_expansion.name: Greater Expansion
greater_expansion.desc: Much larger ability range, plus spirit resistance.

radiant_regeneration.name: Radiant Regeneration
radiant_regeneration.desc: Casting abilities heals you over time and gives move speed.

silence_wave.name: Silence Wave
silence_wave.desc: Active: a wave that damages and silences enemies.

spirit_snatch.name: Spirit Snatch
spirit_snatch.desc: Melee hits deal bonus spirit damage and grant you spirit power and spirit resistance.

arctic_blast.name: Arctic Blast
arctic_blast.desc: Active: a freezing blast that damages and freezes nearby enemies.

cursed_relic.name: Cursed Relic
cursed_relic.desc: Active: silence and disarm a target and reduce the damage they deal.

focus_lens.name: Focus Lens
focus_lens.desc: Active: lower a target's spirit resistance and spirit power and briefly silence them. Also gives fire rate.

lightning_scroll.name: Lightning Scroll
lightning_scroll.desc: Hits a target with a delayed stun, bonus damage and a slow. Also gives health and sprint speed.

mercurial_magnum.name: Mercurial Magnum
mercurial_magnum.desc: Spirit power, a bigger magazine and fire rate; bullets deal bonus spirit damage.

scourge.name: Scourge
scourge.desc: Active: an aura that damages nearby enemies based on their max health, while giving you spirit and status resistance.

spirit_burn.name: Spirit Burn
spirit_burn.desc: Big spirit hits set off a burning explosion that also reduces enemy healing.

vortex_web.name: Vortex Web
vortex_web.desc: Active: throw a web that pulls in and immobilizes enemies caught in it.
